sourceTexts.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אֱלֹהִים לָאוֹר יוֹם וְלַחֹשֶׁךְ קָרָא לָיְלָה וַיְהִי עֶרֶב וַיְהִי בֹקֶר יוֹם אֶחָד

literalTranslations.pt: E chamou Deus à luz dia, e às trevas chamou noite; e houve tarde e houve manhã, dia um.
literalTranslations.en: And God called to the light day, and to the darkness He called night; and there was evening and there was morning, day one.

hebrewWitnesses.label: Codex Leningradensis (B19A)
hebrewWitnesses.text: וַיִּקְרָא אֱלֹהִים לָאוֹר יוֹם וְלַחֹשֶׁךְ קָרָא לָיְלָה וַיְהִי עֶרֶב וַיְהִי בֹקֶר יוֹם אֶחָד
hebrewWitnesses.transliteration: Vayikra Elohim laor yom velachoshek qara laylah vayehi erev vayehi voker yom echad
hebrewWitnesses.literalPt: E chamou Deus à luz dia, e às trevas chamou noite; e houve tarde e houve manhã, dia um.
hebrewWitnesses.literalEn: And God called to the light day, and to the darkness He called night; and there was evening and there was morning, day one.
